features: Compact and lightweight: The world’s lightest supercapacitor rechargeable mouse ensures effortless portability and maneuverability, together with the compact keyboard that is ideal for limited-space environments.
Quiet Performance: Minimize distractions with a silent mouse for enhanced focus.
Smooth & Fatigue-Free Typing: Sleek keyboard with low-profile scissor keys for smooth, quiet typing experience.

Enhanced Palm Support & Better Maneuverability: Designed for comfort with a sloped front, rounder arc, and textured side grip provides added comfort and control, while upgraded feet materials ensure smoother gliding.

Adaptive and Silent Scrolling: The scroll wheel adapts and adjusts intuitively to your speed, effortlessly transitioning between precise movements for controlled navigation and fast scrolling when navigating lengthy documents with ease. Easily switch to horizontal scrolling with a press of the side button.

Uninterrupted productivity: Experience the longest run time among rechargeable supercapacitor-powered keyboards and mice. The keyboard lasts up to 3 months, and the mouse lasts 1.5 months on a full charge. Turbo charge in just five seconds for a full day’s use.
Programmable Buttons and Adjustable DPI: Three programmable buttons and adjustable cursor speed (up to 6K DPI) ensure precision and flexibility for diverse workflows.

Enhanced Security For Peace of Mind: Dell Secure Link USB Receiver (WR3) offers 128-bit AES encryption and is powered by FIPS-approved algorithms trusted by government and enterprise. Further enhanced security protects your data transmissions with Dell Proprietary Technology.
Versatile Connectivity Options: Effortlessly switch between a secure wireless dongle and Bluetooth connection, enabling seamless multi-device pairing and adaptability across various setups.
Push-Push Dongle Storage: An intuitive push-push mechanism ensures easy retrieval and secure storage of the dongle, reducing the risk of loss.
description: Enjoy seamless productivity with this compact keyboard and mouse combo. It features quiet operation, adaptive scrolling, and supercapacitor technology, providing a full day's use with just a 5-second charge.
